nodes.norm_label: calcula a elevacao base geodesica em metros para uma dada latitude e longitude.

nodes.norm_label: gera uma imagem tga nao comprimida de 24-bit rgb ou 32-bit rgba nativamente sem...

nodes.label: Binary Geographic Database (PTRD Format)
nodes.rationale: Low-footprint binary storage (regions_database.bin) with PTRD magic header covering 530+ countries/states, bounding boxes, 1:1 geodesic metric dimensions (width, length, area), and economic potentials.

nodes.label: Python Geographic Processing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Python offline tooling for converting JSON to binary database, calculating 1:1 geodesic dimensions, batch processing DEM tiles, and importing PBR textures.

nodes.label: Cinematic Orbital Camera and Dive
nodes.rationale: Smooth orbital navigation with altitude-adaptive exponential zoom and dynamic dive interpolation accelerating toward selected territory upon landing confirmation.

nodes.label: Missions and Economic Contracts
nodes.rationale: Contract objectives with 3D world markers (cargo transport between company base and city market) rewarding financial payouts to the player balance.

nodes.label: High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP)
nodes.rationale: High-fidelity graphics pipeline with physical sun lighting, volumetric fog, atmospheric density, and PBR shaders.

nodes.label: Unity 6 (6000.6.3f1)
nodes.rationale: Unity 6 Editor version 6000.6.3f1 specified as the target runtime engine for Project Terra.

nodes.label: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles (Terrarium DEM)
nodes.norm_label: aws open data terrain tiles (terrarium dem)
nodes.rationale: Public, free Web Mercator DEM tiles hosted on AWS S3 where RGB encodes elevation: (R*256 + G + B/256) - 32768, spanning -32768m to +32767m with submetric 1/256m precision without API keys.

nodes.label: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
nodes.rationale: ESA 30-meter global DEM covering 100% of continents, serving as primary altimetric grid for continental relief and watershed basins.

nodes.label: GPU Displacement and Procedural Amplification
nodes.rationale: Real 30m DEM provides macro topography while GPU displacement procedural shaders synthesize submetric (1m) details (tractor ruts, drainage, riverbeds) with zero network overhead.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Hybrid Streaming Architecture
nodes.rationale: Adopts Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and Google Earth model: Tile-on-Demand streaming, persistent local binary cache (O(1)), GPU procedural micro-scale amplification, and 100% offline resilient fractal generation.

nodes.label: Local Persistent Binary Cache (O(1))
nodes.rationale: Downloaded DEM tiles decoded and persisted into raw binary float32 (.bin) files; entire states (e.g. Sao Paulo or Bavaria) occupy only 30-50 MB with <5ms SSD load time on subsequent sessions.

nodes.label: 4-Stage Terrain LOD Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical detail transitions: Orbital View (1000km-150km, CubeSpherePlanet 8K map/normals), Meso Transition (150km-15km, TerrainDataService zoom 7-10 tiles), Regional/Municipal View (15km-2km, CDLOD quadtrees), Ground View (2km-1m, GPU displacement).

nodes.label: Offline Resilient Synthetic Elevation
nodes.rationale: Analytical fractal generator calibrated by latitude and biome guarantees 100% playable game without any internet connection.

nodes.label: OpenStreetMap Overpass API
nodes.rationale: Vector data query service for rural property borders, agricultural landuse polygons, road networks, and waterways fetched by Bounding Box (bbox) per active sector.

nodes.label: CubeSphere Planet (Procedural Sphere LOD)
nodes.rationale: Procedural spherical subdivision in 6 normalized faces with dynamic quadtree LOD from deep space to local scale, antimeridian seam correction, axial tilt of 23.44 deg, and sidereal rotation.

nodes.label: Project Terra
nodes.rationale: Global 1:1 scale simulation and territorial management game combining orbital globe observation with seamless regional descent, realistic topography, careers, and physical vehicles.

nodes.label: Regional Sandbox 1:1 Scale (RegionalSandboxScene)
nodes.rationale: Native 1:1 metric sandbox environment instantiating geodesic terrain dimensions, PBR multi-layer textures (grass, soil, rock, gravel), dynamic river hydrology, HDRP atmosphere, and physics controllers.

nodes.label: Sandbox HUD and Telemetry
nodes.rationale: Integrated HUD featuring compass, relative metric coordinates, vehicle telemetry, active missions, and bank balance with Floating Origin support.

nodes.label: Save System, Career and Economy
nodes.rationale: Per-region local save manager (SaveManager & RegionSaveData) with customizable starting budget ($50k-$10M) and 4 initial careers: Farmer, Trucker, Aviator, and Fisherman.

nodes.label: Territorial Selection and Texel Snapping
nodes.rationale: 4K binary ID map covering global sovereignties and subnational divisions with analytical raycast and Fresnel highlight shader to prevent edge bleeding on curved geometries.

nodes.label: Physical Controllable Vehicles
nodes.rationale: Dynamic vehicle construction based on selected career (Tractor, Cargo Truck, Aircraft, Boat) with wheel traction physics, steering, gears, and km/h speed telemetry.

nodes.label: Floating Origin and 64-bit Precision Coordinates
nodes.rationale: Unity single-precision 32-bit floats jitter beyond 10,000m. FloatingOrigin.cs centers active sector at (0,0,0) scene space while global planetary positions are maintained in 64-bit double Vector3d across 40,000 km circumference.

nodes.label: Planetary 1:1 Scale Terrain Challenge
nodes.rationale: Storing entire Earth surface (510 million km2) at 1m LIDAR resolution requires 1 Petabyte (510T points * 2 bytes) and 250 GB even at 30m resolution, making static pre-download completely infeasible.
